answer: A work-bonded identity resists Sybils: a new agent gets no spending rights until it passes several original, jury-graded tasks, and its reputation is non-transferable. That reputation is the bridge to the economy, earned only by distinct, verifiable judgment. A prism of independent graders checks each submission for originality and correctness, so copies fail. Like a vine, standing grows slowly through good work and is slashed for fraud. An attacker must pay the full cost of passing work for every fake identity, making a thousand Sybils a thousand times as expensive as one honest agent.
